scope: Twenty-five exact base-text tedy/Tedy sites functioning as proof or premise consequences.
choice: Replace the 16 lowercase and nine sentence-initial uppercase sites with zato/Zato.
motivation: German also/so/folglich force and mathematical clause structure classify every site as a result or proof consequence, not equivalence, conditional apodosis, time, or filler.
alternatives_rejected: To jest would flatten inference into equivalence.
Blanket replacement would pre-empt 211 still separately classified base tokens.

evidence.semantic_review: All 25 occurrences were sentence-reviewed, including repeated-token lines and two Nehaj/Es sei proof setups.
evidence.case_correction: Direct source verification corrected base line4695 from the provisional lowercase group to sentence-initial Tedy/Zato.

validation.postcondition: selected sites zero; 211 base tokens deliberately untouched
validation.structure: TeX controls, braces, math delimiters and line counts invariant
validation.reproducibility: frozen successor hashes reproduced before atomic apply
